VARIABLE.NAME: SchizophreniaEstablished
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Clinician-confirmed schizophrenia. No means assessed and not confirmed; not missing diagnostic data.
time_window=Current documented assessment; historical treatment dates retained separately
missingness_policy=Leave unobserved when unavailable; never substitute No for absent documentation
parameter_requirement=2 prior entries after graph/dependence review; target-population data or documented elicitation required

VARIABLE.NAME: SubstantialAggressionRisk
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Clinician assesses current risk for aggressive behavior as substantial. Record date, behavior and threat history, current symptoms and context, instrument/version and observation window if used, and rationale. Hostility scores alone do not establish this state. No numeric cutoff is supplied; No does not mean zero risk.
time_window=Current documented assessment; historical treatment dates retained separately
missingness_policy=Leave unobserved when unavailable; never substitute No for absent documentation
parameter_requirement=2 prior entries after graph/dependence review; target-population data or documented elicitation required

VARIABLE.NAME: AggressionRiskPersistsDespiteOtherTreatments
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Aggression Risk Persists Despite Other Treatments

definition=Clinician documents that substantial aggression risk persists despite other treatments, with treatments, dates, response and adherence evidence reviewed. No means assessed criterion not met. Not defined as two failed antipsychotic trials and not equivalent to treatment resistance.
time_window=Current documented assessment; historical treatment dates retained separately
missingness_policy=Leave unobserved when unavailable; never substitute No for absent documentation
parameter_requirement=2 prior entries after graph/dependence review; target-population data or documented elicitation required

VARIABLE.NAME: UrgentSafetyConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=Clinician identifies a need for urgent safety assessment/intervention, including immediate danger to others or self, or serious suspected treatment harm. Present means an identified urgent concern; Absent means assessed and not identified, never missing assessment or a guarantee of safety. Proposed workflow safeguard, not an exhaustive triage tool.
source_locator=Implementation; Balancing of Potential Benefits and Harms in Rating the Strength of the Guideline Statement / Harms
time_window=Current documented assessment; historical treatment dates retained separately
missingness_policy=Leave unobserved when unavailable; never substitute Absent for absent documentation
parameter_requirement=2 prior entries after graph/dependence review; target-population data or documented elicitation required

VARIABLE.NAME: AdherenceConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=A documented adherence problem or uncertainty about actual exposure needs clinical review. This affirmative concern is distinct from entirely missing adherence assessment.
